## [1.3.6] - 2026-11-08

Release 1.3.6. The phone's floor plan works like a seat map: tap TVs on the plan, several at a time, then tap a
source under it and they all switch; the Route picker carries the same plan; a TV's name at the top edge is no longer
cut off; and a fader row no longer jitters while it is dragged.

### Added

- **The phone's floor plan picks the TVs, the list under it picks the source.** The TVs tab's Floor plan view now
  lists the sources under the plan, like a seat map with the shows under it: tap dots to select TVs, several at a
  time, then tap a source and every selected TV switches to it; a tap on the plan itself clears. The selected TVs
  sit in a strip over the list, and a tap on one opens its page (remote, channels, power). With nothing selected a
  source tap lights the TVs showing it on the plan, and the search box fades the dots that do not match. Sources ›
  **Route** opens with the same plan on top of its TV list, so a source can be sent by tapping dots as well as
  rows. The zone chips under the plan follow Settings › Phones › TVs tab › **Zones on the tab**, the same order and
  hidden set as the list.
- **A TV's name cut off at the top of the phone's plan.** A selected dot near the top edge drew its name above the
  dot, outside the plan's box, so it was clipped; the name now sits below such a dot, and hugs the near side at the
  left and right edges.
- **A fader row jittered while it was dragged.** A level readout grew and shrank with its digits ("5%" to "100%"),
  which resized the fader sharing its column (a source inside a mix, the Audio pane's source strips) so the thumb
  jumped under the finger, and could hop a readout between lines of a wrapping button row. Every readout now has
  the width of its widest value, so no row reflows while a fader moves; the sources inside a mix, where the readout
  sits on the line right above the fader, drop the drag bubble that covered the source's name.
